decision_rules_text: flip the sampler default to an arm iff C1 geomean >= 1.15 over 17, C2 no model < 0.85, C3 gates >= da, C4 funnel |z| <= 2 every seed, C5 Eight Schools >= 0.9x da; highest C1 among qualifying arms; labelled final commit with tests/sampler_api.rs updates; otherwise no default change. Report all cells; no reruns; failures are results; nothing tuned after seeing results.
purpose: WP34. On ordinary posteriors oWALNUTS runs as NUTS with a slightly worse per-gradient efficiency (posteriordb_bench_v5: 0.67-0.95x CmdStan per healthy model). The JMLR paper's promise is the opposite: with refinement doing the local work, the macro step h should be LARGER than NUTS's step and the fixed cost of the rare refined leaf repaid by fewer leaves per orbit elsewhere. Phase 1 instruments the shipped defaults (h vs CmdStan's adapted step, refined-leaf fraction and level, a level-0 leaf-error trace at multiples of h); phase 2 preregisters and runs arms that try to realise the promise.

instrumentation.what: the shipped defaults on the v5 seed 87101 (expected to reproduce the v5 owalnuts-da cell bit-for-bit: same gradients, same min ESS), with the refinement accounting and the leaf-error trace; CmdStan's adapted step per model is the median of the twelve v5 CmdStan chain steps (three seeds x four chains) and is passed to the harness as the trace's reference step
